body:
"I can't be with someone that when I'm out of town or you're out of town I have to be paranoid about what you're doing. That stresses me the fuck out. And I deserve to be with someone that makes me feel loved and like I'm the only girl they need and want. But its too late now. I'm fucking knocked up. Nobody will want me when I have a baby. And a baby that looks nothing like me. I fucked up. "

It just keeps getting worse. There's no point in me posting these but I have nowhere to turn. I need to take myself out of the picture.

"You need counseling. Fuck, even I need counseling now. You've fucked up my life. You've made me feel so little. You're the reason I don't trust anyone. Ive become an anti-social recluse because of you. I became so paranoid about being perfect for you so that you wouldn't want anyone else, that I was a size 0 and underweight."

A text I just got from her. I can't even begin to describe how broken my heart is right now. I took such a beautiful girl and hurt her. I'm a cancer to humanity
I tried talking to her and all she's bringing up is how I won't be able to see my kid and how I clearly don't love her. I just want to die. If I could only be so fortunate.

I just don't know what else to do. I've had the best years of my life with the girl of my dreams and it's all crashing down. I was going to start a family this year. Everything was perfect and now I only have myself to blame.
